mode: exploratory diagnostic oracle using test labels; not an evaluated model
question: How much can a fixed 5% cell budget gain by reallocating between fixed crop Q5 and non-Q5?

definition.budget: K=floor(0.05*n_prefecture_cells), identical for current and all allocations
definition.within_stratum_order: subsequence of original statewide metrics.rank_order(saved B_env score,seed=0)
definition.capture_by_q5_cells: at each integer k: positives among first k Q5 plus first K-k non-Q5, divided by all prefecture positives
definition.oracle_tie_break: nearest optimal k to current global top-K allocation, then smaller k; min/max of all ties also stored
definition.original_fractional_capture: saved evaluation metric with fractional boundary cell, reference only

limitations: The oracle chooses allocation after observing B2/B3 labels. Its gain is an in-sample ceiling, not out-of-sample improvement or a deployable policy. Fixed within-stratum ranks cannot repair their own mistakes. B3 labels cover April-September only; observation bias and spatial dependence remain.
